definitions.explanation: The unit of reproduction in plants.
The origin or cause of something.
Subject matter for discussion or creation.

examples.english: To become a source of worry.

notes:
{種|たね} has both literal (seed) and figurative (source/topic) meanings.

LITERAL USES (seeds):
- {種|たね}を{蒔|ま}く: to sow seeds
- {種|たね}を{取|と}る: to save/harvest seeds
- ひまわりの{種|たね}: sunflower seeds
- {花|はな}の{種|たね}: flower seeds

FIGURATIVE USES (source/cause):
- {話|はなし}の{種|たね}: topic of conversation
- {笑|わら}いの{種|たね}: source of laughter
- {心配|しんぱい}の{種|たね}: cause of worry
- {悩|なや}みの{種|たね}: source of trouble
- ニュースの{種|たね}: news material

IDIOM:
{種|たね}も{仕掛|しか}けもない: no tricks (literally 'no seeds or mechanisms' - used by magicians)

RELATED:
- {苗|なえ}: seedling (plant that has sprouted)
- {実|み}: fruit, seed (of fruit)
